bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Relays the remote service's own result unchanged; it computes no number of its own, so the service is the authority for what comes back.
bio.jane/contract.question: What does the authority named return for this ontology term, pathway or cell type?

description: Resolve an ontology term, taxon, pathway or cell type: OLS ontologies, NCBI Taxonomy, QuickGO annotations, Reactome pathways, KEGG entries, Rfam RNA families, CellGuide/PanglaoDB cell types and markers, an antibody RRID, or an identifiers.org prefix and the pattern its ids follow.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

query.description: a term, accession or command such as "get_go_annotations:P04637" or "map_reactome_pathways:TP53".

name: lookup_ontology

count.description: how many records came back, which is a result even when it is zero

envelope.description: the authority's whole answer: paging, totals and the query it actually ran

provenance.description: the authority, the exact endpoints called and when — what makes an answer re-checkable without re-running it

records.description: the records the authority returned, in its own field names — wire them into a tool that takes ids, or read them in the transcript
